note: Source validated against the official Kumon UK and Singapore curricula (2026). Maths: levels 7A to O plus the X specialty tracks (XV Vectors, XM Transformations, XP Permutations, XS Statistics). English: 18 main levels 7A to L, with sub levels AI/AII through GI/GII for levels A to G. H to L are single levels. The final English level is L.
warning: This roadmap is maintained by hand and can lag behind the real worksheet content. Check it against the current week before trusting it.

items.name: 7A - 2A
items.detail: Early numeracy: counting, number recognition, writing 1-100, mental addition +1 to +10

items.name: Level A
items.detail: Addition (sum up to 28), subtraction from up to 20, 200 sheets, SCT 1-3 min

items.name: Level B
items.detail: 2 & 3-digit addition/subtraction with carrying/borrowing, first word problems, SCT 1-5 min

items.label: Level C, Current (20 sub-topics, SCT 2-5 min/sheet)

items.name: C1-4
items.detail: Multiplication tables ×1-×3, ×1-×5, ×1-×7, ×1-×9 (recall drills)

items.name: C5-10
items.detail: 2-digit × 1-digit (5 progressive sections) · 3 or 4-digit × 1-digit · short division now being introduced in worksheets

items.name: C11
items.detail: Introduction to Division

items.name: C12-15
items.detail: Division with Remainders (4 sections)

items.name: C16-17
items.detail: Division: 2-digit ÷ 1-digit (2 sections)

items.name: C18-20
items.detail: Division: 3-digit ÷ 1-digit (2 sections), Level C complete

items.label: Level D, Next target (20 sub-topics, SCT 2-6 min/sheet)

items.name: D1-4
items.detail: 2-digit × 2-digit (3 sections), 3-digit × 2-digit

items.name: D5-8
items.detail: Mixed add/subtract, multiplication & division, division by 2-digit numbers (5 sections)

items.name: D9-12
items.detail: Division: quotients of 2+ digits, intro Fractions, Reduction (4 sections, GCF)

items.name: Levels E-F
items.detail: All fraction operations (×÷+−), fraction/decimal conversions, order of operations, word problems

items.name: Levels G-H
items.detail: Negative integers, linear equations, simultaneous equations, functions & graphs

items.name: Levels I-O
items.detail: Factorisation, quadratics, Pythagoras, trigonometry, calculus, SCT up to 30-60 min

items.name: X-Levels
items.detail: XV Vectors, XM Transformations, XP Permutations & Combinations, XS Statistics (advanced elective tracks)

items.name: 7A - 3A
items.detail: Phonics, word recognition, sight words, short passages, basic comprehension

items.name: Level 2A
items.detail: Longer passages, sequencing, nouns/verbs/adjectives, 50-word passage fluency

items.name: AI
items.detail: Structure of simple sentences, subject & predicate, basic punctuation

items.name: AII
items.detail: Sentence structure, thought sequence, vocabulary building, comprehension Q&A

items.name: BI
items.detail: Subject/predicate deeper, past-tense expressions, modifiers, 5W-1H questions

items.name: BII
items.detail: Comparing & contrasting, reading speed 85 wpm, figurative language mastery

items.name: CI
items.detail: Constructing sentences, correct word order

items.name: CII
items.detail: Organising information, tenses and voices

items.name: DI
items.detail: Combining sentences, relative clauses

items.name: DII
items.detail: Main idea, understanding paragraphs, reported speech

items.label: Levels E - G (sub-levels EI/EII to GI/GII)

items.name: EI-EII
items.detail: Topic and main idea of paragraphs, scene transition, reason and result

items.name: FI-FII
items.detail: Links within sentences (referring words, restatement), diagramming paragraphs, interpreting text

items.name: GI-GII
items.detail: Paragraph elements, impressions, sentiment, single-paragraph summary

items.name: H - I
items.detail: Extended summarisation, character sentiment, key word relationships, concise comprehension answers

items.name: J - L
items.detail: Critical reading: plot, atmosphere, irony, literary characters, figurative language analysis, objective commentary, Level L is the final English level
